name: cg-dynamics
description_for_human: Private CG Production House operating remote: brief yourself from your CG Assistant profile, see today's work, retrieve exact-client context, close out content runs, and draft governed lead follow-ups. Staff workspace only.
description_for_model: Private assistant surface for CG Production House. One communal ChatGPT account holds a single OAuth connection signed in as the company admin, so the connection does NOT identify the staff member or client. In every fresh Project chat call resolve_project_context once, then pass that exact context object on every tool call: a staff Project acts as that exact staff member, a client Project is pinned to that exact client, and company_admin must be asked for explicitly. Never reuse another Project context, never infer identity from the Project title, chat history or the connected account, and never fuzzy-match a staff or client name. All live data, authorization and actions come from the registered CG Dynamics MCP connection — this package only supplies the workflow skills. Prefer live retrieval over stale ChatGPT Project memory. Email is DRAFT-ONLY; never send.
starter_prompts: Brief yourself from my CG Assistant profile.
I'm done with Red Oak's shoot.
Check whether today's footage is uploaded.
Research this lead and draft the follow-up email.
notes: This is a private workspace plugin. The `apps` / `.app.json` MCP mapping is intentionally omitted here: it is added only after the real CG Dynamics MCP connection is created in ChatGPT Developer mode and a real `plugin_asdk_app...` technical ID exists. See ../CONNECTION-HANDOFF.md. Do not add a placeholder connector ID.
